test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie-chart shows the spendings of a sports academy on various sports during a particular year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdfe1c01632ee17cc9ccf9ef85c8e127da843970710eedf23500d908692f1c1a.png] 

How much percentage more is spent on Hockey than that on Golf?
solution:
**Given:**

Angle for Hockey = 63°

Angle for Golf = 36°

**Formula used:**

Percentage more = ((Hockey - Golf) / Golf) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Percentage more = ((63 - 36) / 36) × 100

⇒ Percentage more = (27 / 36) × 100

⇒ Percentage more = 0.75 × 100

⇒ Percentage more = 75%

**∴ 75% more is spent on Hockey than on Golf.**
